lines.text: Put two hundred dots around a circle, and number them.
Now connect every number to its double. Ten to twenty, twenty to forty, thirty to sixty.
Keep going, and a heart appears. It's called a cardioid.
Times three gives a nephroid, shaped like a kidney.
Keep raising the multiplier, and the pattern keeps transforming.
All of this comes from one rule: multiply, then connect.
Pause on your favourite one, and tell me the number.

post.title: Multiply by 2 on a circle and a heart appears
post.description: 200 dots on a circle, each joined to its double: a cardioid. Times 3 makes a nephroid, and every multiplier draws something new. Made with code.
